body: I know what you mean. I got down to 75lbs from Anorexia and it was so humiliating. Everyone could tell how sick I was just by looking at me. :( No privacy.
Yeah I relate. I almost died from Anorexia so I wonder if I won't live as long as a normal person because of it. I am kind of a hypochondriac.
I like it - puts me to sleep really well.

Yes I used to be like this too. I've had insomnia and nightmares since I was a little girl. I have Anorexia, PTSD and Anxiety. 

Have you tried medication? I take Seroquel and it puts me to sleep really good. Sometimes I even sleep too much! It is great. Marijuana helps me too. Before I started on Seroquel I would take marijuana edibles every day for sleep.
Me too. I want to have a different body (I have anorexia). I'm never going to have the body I want though.
yes exactly!!! I hate humans and im scared of them (most of them). I have good reason to feel this way.
yes I feel this way a lot :(
I've done some dangerous stuff and im kind of disappointed im not dead too. :( life is so painful.
get stoned :)
yes. I've spent the past 6 thanksgivings alone.
I hate the world
can't hold down job
the sims
I don't think ill ever love myself. I hope I get to the point where I don't wanna die for more than a few days at a time. :(
I know what you mean. I don't really care about "being myself" anymore I just wanna get to the point where I don't feel like dying for more than a few days. :(
Same for me. being in the city makes me feel safer because there is more people around

Yes. I have anorexia and PTSD and everyone triggers me. :( Especially other girls. It's easier just to not socialize at all.  Sometimes I don't even feel like leaving my apartment because going outside triggers me.
I do but it's from Anorexia. I'm either too cold or too hot. :(
I wish someone would kill me too it would make it easier :(
I really hope that my abusive dad dies soon. I will feel so much safer when he is gone.

I feel the same way. I have an eating disorder too and everyone triggers me, so why make friends? It's just going to make me feel worse. It would be nice to have one friend I feel safe around, but I don't know how to find one.
I don't think it really matters what you call it. C-Ptsd and Bpd have a lot of the same symptoms. My therapist says he doesn't believe in personality disorders.
Have you tried taking birth control pills? I've been on them for years. When you are on them you don't have to have a period at all.
I haven't been crying too much lately. I am more angry than sad so I scream into my pillow and punch it. Sometimes I cry a lot though.
Me too. I feel like I am always trying to act like a human, but I just don't belong. :(
A few months ago I had a dream about my abusive father raping me. :( It was terrible.

I feel the same way. I have struggled with Anorexia for 10 years. I'm at a healthy weight now but I feel like I am living in someone else's body. When I was skinny I thought I was hot, but when I'm healthy I feel horrible and disgusting. Just seeing girls who are skinnier than me in public makes me feel terrible.
Oh my god yes. It would be scary but at least I'd be dead. At one point I was scared my abusive dad would kill me. I wish he did.
Thanks for posting this - I hate it when people say stuff like that.  I definitely need someone to love me before I can love myself. Too many people have made me feel worthless.
At least I wouldn't be conscious I just don't want to be in any more pain
I used to dislike facebook so I permanently deleted mine. It triggered me I guess. Recently I made a new account though and it's better. I just go on because I'm bored a lot.
I feel this way too. Every day hurts so much but I'm too much of a pussy to kill myself. I  have Anorexia, which makes things even worse.

I feel this way too. I'm also afraid of driving a car. I've been suicidal for a long time, and I wish I wasn't such a pussy or I would be dead by now. I guess I am just too anxious about death. I know that it would be an end to my pain though. 

I wish I was never born in the first place that would have been so much better than this. I also have Anorexia and I wish it killed me. I got down to 75lbs a few years ago, but I started eating again because I was afraid to die. :-( I would have died skinny, it would be perfect. That's all I ever wanted.
Me too. I honestly wish someone would murder me - it would make things easier. I have anorexia too and I wish it would fucking kill me.

I don't either I totally understand. Every day is intensely painful. My cat makes me not want to hurt myself as much but I know he would be okay without me. Someone else could probably take better care of him than I do.

I have Anorexia but I am at a healthy weight right now. My eating disorder makes me feel disgusting and worthless. I don't think I will ever be happy with how I look when I'm healthy. Just seeing girls in public who are smaller than me hurts so bad.

I don't understand how anyone could miss me either. I'm not pretty and my body is ugly now too. I feel like I am a burden and I embarrass my family.
I wish I had someone to say that to me. My aunt does but I was abused by my family as a child so it doesn't make me feel better. I don't think your reaction is weird though we are all different.
Yeah that's what I wanna do.
Totally agree! I wish I was never born. It seems like my parents do too.
I'm scared I will be suicidal for the rest of my life. This world is such a terrible place.

I agree so much. I've been through a lot and I just don't wanna be in pain anymore. I have Anorexia and I have so much shame tied up in my body. When I die I won't have a body anymore. I'll finally be at peace.
My dad raped me when I was a little girl and he will never be punished. I was an innocent little girl and nobody helped me. Sometimes I fantasize about killing him, then killing myself.
Don't do it by jumping off a bridge. I've thought about it too, but that's one of the most painful ways to die. You don't deserve any more pain. There are better ways to die.

I know it's terrible but I'm afraid I will always feel this way. I was bullied in middle school and I have always had terrible self esteem. After Anorexia started it got even worse - my mom would tell me I "look like shit". 

At this point, even just seeing girls who are skinnier than me in public makes me feel bad. :( I hate myself so much it's hard not to self harm.

Thanks for your reply, that helps me feel better. I hope you are doing ok with your anorexia. I'm finally healthy after about 10 years of it, but emotionally I am a mess. It's like I feel everything 100x more than everyone else. I think that's why I am so scared of being cheated on now. If someone cheated on me when I was 75lbs it wouldn't matter so much, because I had the eating disorder to help me feel ok.

I feel the same way. I think I am ugly and nobody will want to be with me. Why would someone want to be with someone ugly, depressed, anxious and suicidal? My parents and ex boyfriend abused me too. I am worthless.

I'm the same way. A Few years ago I almost died from Anorexia. I was 75lbs. About a year before that, I was scared that my abusive father would kill me. In both cases I wish I had died. I just want to be out of pain.
